card.name: Interferon and Lancet citations, renal warnings
card.fires_on: Fires on a few fixed phrases: the 'interfer' piece in (peg)interferon, the end of 'Lancet', and 'effects' in 'These effects are usually reversible' after a renal-failure warning.

modes.label: Renal warning sentence
modes.description: The word 'effects' in the repeated sentence after ACE inhibitor or receptor antagonist renal function warnings.
modes.example: may result in deterioration of renal function, including possible acute renal failure. These<< effects>> are usually reversible. Monitor renal function periodically
